title: Heronswood Garden

services.name: Weddings & Rentals
services.desc: Heronswood Garden is a wonderful botanical garden and wedding venue located in Kingston, Washington, that boasts a unique picturesque beauty. Residing among the lush landscapes of the Pacific Northwest and a rare inventory of unusual trees, shrubs, vines and flowers, this venue is perfect for a one-of-a-kind outdoor wedding celebration. Located in Kingston, WA, just a ferry ride away from Seattle or Edmonds. The process of creating Heronswood Garden started in 1987 when the co-founders took possession of the property and transformed it over the next two decades into a garden of international renown. services.name: Garden Tours
services.desc: Private guided tours are available year-round and last approximately two hours. They are led by senior garden staff and cost $300 minimum, covering up to 10 people, then $30 per additional person (e.g., 15 people=$450). Tours are scheduled first come, first served, generally on Wednesdays and Fridays, and payment is required in advance. Upcoming public guided tours, when available, are scheduled and bookable through our Heronswood Events & Classespage. All webinars take place virtually via Zoom.
